messages.author: e9cc24d7b29070f1
messages.subject: Multilevel Sample Moments
parts:
Hi all,


lavInspect(object, "sampstat") gives the observed sample statistics, it includes the 'ordinary' covariances that cov2cor() will transform into 'ordinary' Pearson correlations in a single-level model.


In a two-level model, sampstat gives the upper and the lower covariance, then I also apply cov2cor() to get correlations.


But the values are not the same as the ones provided by the function statsBy from the R package ‘psych’, a main purpose of statsBy is: "Perhaps the most useful part of statsBy is that it decomposes the observed correlations between variables into two parts: the within group and the between group correlation."

And psych manual adds "This follows the decomposition of an observed correlation... …discussed by Pedazur (1997) and by Bliese in the multilevel package."


It seems there are at least to ways to decompose the observed correlation. I would appreciate if somebody could confirm it.

And if so, could I get a reference of the procedure in lavaan (as package ‘psych’ prints Pedazur and Bliese in the manual)? A published paper (using lavaan) specifying the reference of the multilevel sample moments would be equivalent.


Please, note this is not about Implied moments of the model. Just sample moments in multilevel (decomposition of observed correlations).


Thank you very much in advance for your help!


Xavier Suriol

 

Syntax in lavaan:

lavInspect(<two-level fit object>, "sampstat")

cov2cor(lavInspect(object, "sampstat")[[1]][[1]]) # to get the lower level correlation

cov2cor(lavInspect(object, "sampstat")[[2]][[1]]) # to get the upper level correlation

 

Syntax in psych:

library(psych)

multilevelPsych <- statsBy(Dataset[c(<variables>,"SelfCode")],group="SelfCode")

multilevelPsych$rwg # correlation in the lower level

multilevelPsych$rbg # correlation in the upper level

Thank you veru much, Terrence, for your reply. I appreciate it.

The syntax is:


library(lavaan)
model <- '
level: 1
fw =~ y1 + y2 + y3
fw ~ x1 + x2 + x3
level: 2
fb =~ y1 + y2 + y3
fb ~ w1 + w2
'
fit <- sem(model, data = Demo.twolevel, cluster = "cluster")
summary(fit)
cov2cor(lavInspect(fit, "sampstat")[[1]][[1]]) # sample moments - correlation lower level in lavaan
cov2cor(lavInspect(fit, "sampstat")[[2]][[1]]) # sample moments - correlation upper level in lavaan

library(psych)
multilevelPsych <- statsBy(Demo.twolevel[c("y1","y2","y3","x1","x2","x3","w1","w2","cluster")],group="cluster")
multilevelPsych$rwg # correlation lower level in psych
multilevelPsych$rbg # correlation upper level in psych
